Scorekeeping notation and the sabermetric ladder have no wiki concept pages; those `source` fields are `''` and the questions follow `curriculum-t6.js`.

### 6. Deviations
None on shape, ids, or quiz coverage. Analytics questions test what each stat answers and what it hides; no item’s correct answer is a current league-average constant.
